subject: ACME - Invoice estimate and cost model
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: ACME — Post-call recap & cost qualification

Jordan — great to connect earlier. Quick recap from today's discovery and the items I promised to follow up on: 

- Estimated monthly token volumes (your guidance): 100M active user interactions, average 300 tokens/request => ~30M tokens for prompts + 70M for completions = ~100M tokens/month (flexible +/− 30%).
- Target unit economics you mentioned: looking to land around $800–$1,200 per 1M tokens for a hosted+dedicated blended rate depending on SLA/throughput needs.
- Primary success criteria: latency < 250ms p50, availability SLA 99.9% for public-facing features, predictable monthly cost for finance.

Next steps / asks from ACME: 
1) Confirm the monthly token range (low / expected / high).
2) Confirm target ARR/budget band (you mentioned a $150k–$300k yearly commitment range on the call).
3) Introduce procurement contact if you want a formal quote/invoice for internal approval.

I’ll assemble a short invoice estimate and a cost-model (spreadsheet) showing hosted vs dedicated illustrations and send it back today. Attaching a lightweight pricing calculator for your review in the next message.

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0199

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACME — Post-call recap & cost qualification

Thanks Sean — quick answers inline: 

- Token volumes: the 100M/month estimate is the expected baseline. Peak could be 140–150M in Q4. Low season ~60M.
- Budget: the product team has signaled a willingness to target $1,000 per 1M tokens as a working number (so $100k/month at baseline), but procurement will push for committed pricing if we want that rate.
- Procurement: looping in procurement@acme.com for next steps on quote/PO. They will need a formal invoice/quote with line items (hosting, reserved capacity, overage rates, support tier).

Can you share: 
1) A simple hosted vs dedicated cost comparison at 100M and 140M tokens.
2) Any volume discounts or reserved commit tiers (monthly/annual) and the breakpoints.
3) Confirmation of any additional fees (e.g., data egress, premium SLA).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Jordan

Jordan Lee
Product Lead, AI Services | ACME Corp
jordan.lee@acme.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 2 Feb 2027 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: ACME — Invoice estimate & cost model (attached)

Jordan / Procurement — attaching a concise invoice estimate and the pricing calculator per our conversation. Attachments: ACME_pricing_calculator_v1.xlsx, ACME_invoice_estimate_v1.pdf, acme_cost_breakdown_20270202.csv (see metadata).

Inline summary (baseline = 100M tokens/month):
- Hosted (pay-as-you-go): ~ $1,250 per 1M tokens effective list -> baseline monthly cost ~$125,000. Pros: no commit, fast onboarding. Cons: higher unit price at scale.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity, 1-year commit): target blended rate ~ $900 per 1M tokens -> baseline monthly cost ~$90,000. Assumptions: 1-year reserved pool sized for 100M tokens/month, standard support. Includes prefix caching and optimized batching.
- Hybrid (reserved + burst hosted): blended ~ $980 per 1M tokens -> baseline monthly cost ~$98,000 plus overage at hosted rates. Good if you want predictable spend with burst capacity.

Other line items to note: 
- Premium SLA (99.95%) + Priority Support: +$5k/month flat.
- Data egress: typical cloud egress applies; in our spreadsheet we assumed $0.02/GB for export scenarios (negligible for text-only flows).
- Estimated 12-month blended TCO (conservative): $1.08M–$1.35M depending on commit and growth.

Attached spreadsheet contains: detailed per-token math, model variants (smaller quantized model vs full-precision), expected p50/p95 latency bands, and a simple invoice PDF suitable for procurement review. 

Next suggested steps: 
1) Procurement review the attached invoice and confirm required PO fields.
2) If you want the Dedicated quote formalized, I can convert the spreadsheet into a signed quote and route to legal for standard SOW/Order Form.
3) If you want to test performance first, we can spin a 2-week proof-of-value on a small dedicated pool (discounted) so you can validate latency/throughput.

If it helps I can host a 30-min walkthrough of the calculator tomorrow.

Thanks — Sean

--
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0199

Jordan
